Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B.

Start at fyy: the pair (fyy, knb) comes first; its second item is knb, so the next pair is the one whose first item is knb: (knb, ...).

The first item of (knb, ...) is knb, so we look for a pair where the first item is knb. The only pair that fits is (knb, fyy).

The second item of (knb, fyy) is fyy, but fyy never appears as a first item
